verdict.rationale: Steel documents an automatic-solving captcha stance. A dedicated CAPTCHA solving page says one session flag covers detection, solving, and verification, and a Captchas API section exists for managing captcha state. A separate human-in-the-loop debug URL lets a person take control of a session, though the docs never tie it to captcha fallback. Missing for 10: documented behavior when solving fails (error surfacing vs. silent failure), an explicit captcha-to-human fallback flow, supported captcha types and success rates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
